title: Investigate unexpected source-sighting validator panic in the ordinary-reporting worker
outcome: Identify and correct or explicitly disposition the unexpected background-worker source identity rejection without weakening the SourceId contract; aggregate test success alone does not resolve it.
acceptance: The original unexpected panic is preserved with its exact run, input, timestamp, thread, location and full journal/backtrace, and the investigation identifies the owning fixture/path and falsifiable cause or records an independently concurred bounded unresolved disposition.

Any confirmed product or fixture defect is corrected with a discriminating behavior check, preserving strict SourceId validation; the original panic is explicitly accounted for independently of later aggregate passes.

completion.summary: Landed on master as 5b3ca013 (11:41Z). The unexpected termal-unadmitted-observation panic was a host-shutdown race: retirement cancels the capture before joining the observation worker, and EngramSourceId::validate honoured that cancellation, so a complete source identity read as malformed and the reporting fixture unwrapped the refusal. Reproduced deterministically by RED checks (exact seq4 text; exact :115:81 panic). Fix: the in-memory identity check runs outside the capture's cancellation through without_capture_cancellation; shape rules and budget deadline unchanged; a sighting met by shutdown stays Pending for replay (coordinator conditions met). Review pairs R2 and R3 clean; landing FULL test-efdaab04 green; registered run a517f8ba at the landed commit; post-landing evaluation 7599a39b passed both criteria. Follow-ups filed: w-742a654d4cf5 (P3 test coverage), w-53edd04720de (P3 pre-existing pattern).
